scenarios.context: Two people meet at a party.

speakerA.en: What do you do for a living?

speakerB.en: I'm a nurse. I work at a big hospital.
Yes, I love helping people, but the hours are long.

speakerA.en: Why do you want this job?

speakerB.en: I'm Ali. I have three years of experience as a cashier.
I like working with customers, and I learn quickly.
Yes, I can start any day.

scenarios.context: Two friends talk about their work.

speakerA.en: How many hours do you work a week?

speakerB.en: Forty hours, from Monday to Friday.
Sometimes, but I get a day off in the week.
It's OK. I'd like to earn a little more.

speakerA.en: Hi, I'm the new accountant. My name is Lina.
Where can I have lunch here?

speakerB.en: Welcome, Lina! I'm Mark. I work in sales.
There's a cafeteria on the second floor.
Yes, and the food is good. I'll show you at lunchtime.

scenarios.context: Two friends talk about the past.

speakerA.en: What did you want to be when you were young?
Really? Why didn't you become one?

speakerB.en: I wanted to be a pilot.
It was too expensive, so I studied engineering.
Yes, I do. It's interesting, and I'm good at it.
